preconditions.description: n and k are positive integers with 1 ≤ k < n ≤ 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is between 1 and n inclusive.
All integers in the output are distinct.

postconditions.expression: len(set(abs(return_value[i] - return_value[i+1]) for i in range(n-1))) == k
postconditions.description: The group of numbers |p_1 - p_2|, |p_2 - p_3|, ..., |p_{n-1} - p_n| has exactly k distinct elements.
